paper_title: Constraints on dark photon dark matter using data from LIGO's and Virgo's third observing run
coupling_convention: epsilon^2_95% — SQUARED dark photon U(1)_B coupling strength, exactly as plotted on the y-axis (not linear epsilon, not kinetic mixing chi)
notes: LVK O3 search for dark photon dark matter coupled to baryon number U(1)_B, mass range ~1e-14 to 1e-11 eV (10-2000 Hz). Only the two best-point numerical values are quoted in text: cross-correlation method eps^2 ~ 2.65e-46 at m_A ~ 4.31e-13 eV; BSD excess-power method eps^2 ~ 2.4e-47 at m_A ~ 5.7e-13 eV. Full frequency-dependent limits are in Fig. 3 (not numerically extractable from text). Note this is a U(1)_B gauge boson coupling eps (relative to e), not kinetic mixing chi — enum lacks a U(1)_B category, so DarkPhoton is used per the hint; VectorBL was considered but paper's primary result is U(1)_B (B-L limits obtained by multiplying by 4). Local DM density value not explicitly stated in extracted text.
